Cultivating creative leadership for sports industry advancement
The contemporary era has witnessed expanding sports industry markets globally, driven by rising income levels and increased leisure time. This has
resulted in heightened sports participation and enthusiasm, establishing the sports industry as a significant economic sector in major economies
worldwide.
The Sports Management program addresses these evolving market dynamics by cultivating industry leadership professionals. The curriculum
transcends theoretical sports knowledge, advancing into practical strategies for value creation and monetization in the sports business. The program
emphasizes experiential learning through field experiences and professional internships across diverse industry sectors.
The curriculum incorporates a comprehensive analysis of sports spectator behavior and a quantitative evaluation of professional team media exposure
across television and digital platforms, measuring direct and indirect team valuations. These analyses inform the development of marketing strategies
and revenue enhancement methodologies for sports organizations and spectator sports operations. The program addresses emerging sports
business sectors, including e-sports, sports betting industries, and sports entrepreneurship, providing comprehensive education in contemporary
sports business domains.

Some international students may face problems with verifying their academic records or visas after returning to their home countries.
This change is in accordance with the guidelines of the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Korea, so we ask for the understanding and active cooperation of all international students.
Thank you.
